why: `(support, locator, domain_id)`: an explicit middleware locator and ROS domain. A device has no environment to read `NROS_LOCATOR` / `ROS_DOMAIN_ID` from and no argv, so the image states them. `rclc_support_init` takes rclc's `(support, argc, argv, allocator)` since phase-492 W1.b and resolves both from the build (and the environment on a hosted target).
